exports.deapiImageAdapter: default image adapter instance (guarded generate adapter, responseFormats [url, b64_json])
exports.deapiVideoAdapter: default video adapter instance (VIDEO_GENERATION_ADAPTERS contract, responseFormats [b64_json])
exports.createDeapiImageAdapter: factory; options { timeoutMs, now } for tests
exports.createDeapiVideoAdapter: factory; options { timeoutMs, submitTimeoutMs, requestTimeoutMs, contentTimeoutMs, pollIntervalMs, maxPolls, wait, now } for tests
exports.buildDeapiImageRequest: (model, body) -> { model, prompt, n?, size?, quality?, response_format?, style? }; throws status 400
exports.buildDeapiVideoRequest: (model, body) -> { model, prompt, seconds?: string, size? }; throws status 400
exports.runDeapiVideoJob: submit + bounded poll + bounded /content read; { success, bytes, job, jobId } or error result with acceptedJob
exports.deapiAcceptedJob: (modality, jobState) accepted-job accounting with unknown cost
exports.deapiPublicUrl: public https URL check used for image results
exports.DEAPI_IMAGE_MODELS: image catalog metadata; Z-Image models carry square supportedSizes

provider.sourceAlias: deapi (same as the id, so no extra alias key)

notEquivalent.deepai: different vendor: api.deepai.org text2img, multipart body, api-key header
notEquivalent.generic OpenAI image adapter (imageProvi: reads imageConfig.baseUrl of a registered provider; no deapi entry exists, it defaults n=1 and size=1024x1024 and forwards OpenAI output options deAPI does not take
notEquivalent.custom OpenAI-compatible node: user-supplied base URL; would send the key wherever configured and has no deAPI video job
notEquivalent./v1/videos proxy (videoCore.js): no deapi videoConfig, hands job ids to the client, no accepted-job ledger and no key-gated content download

models.rawIds: none; only the catalog ids are sent
models.dynamicDiscovery: none in the source; static registry lists

notStaged.tts: source audioRegistry deapi /v1/audio/speech; separate inventory row
notStaged.stt: source audioRegistry deapi /v1/audio/transcriptions; separate inventory row
notStaged.embeddings: source embeddingRegistry deapi /v1/embeddings; separate inventory row
